title: Proventus Agrocom Ltd. (NSE Emerge: PROV) — Company Dossier
sector: Consumer Staples / Branded Dry Fruits & Healthy Snacking
support_zone_explanation: Our zone of ₹1,850 to ₹1,875 sits on the S1 pivot (₹1,864) and the lower half of the August-November base (weekly closes ₹1,845 to ₹1,982). The 50-day SMA (₹1,900.75) is the line above which we do nothing: from ₹1,900 the reward-to-risk to the ₹2,216 base target is 1.52:1, a knife-edge that earns only the 14% hurdle. The snapshot's ₹1,913.77 to ₹1,999.81 zone is built on the 10-week and 20-day EMAs, which this stock pierces on a few hundred shares, and gives 0.70:1. From ₹1,875 the ratio is 1.86:1 and from ₹1,850 it is 2.32:1.
stop_placement_explanation: The ₹1,692.11 stop is a weekly close, not an intraday print: it sits under the rising 30-week SMA (₹1,718) and the September 2026 week low (₹1,658). On a tape with a median of 320 shares a day a stop is an alert, not a guaranteed exit price.
primer: Proventus Agrocom imports, packs and sells dry fruits and snacks, mostly under its ProV brand. Profit is real but thin: EBITDA before other income was 1.99% of FY2026 revenue, and H1 FY27 operating cash flow was negative. New capital is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT, with an entry zone of ₹1,850 to ₹1,875 and a stop at ₹1,692.11. The H1 FY27 results came after the 13 November close, so the market has not reacted. You hold no shares, and spare cash goes 25% to AJMERA and 75% to cash.
holding_rationale: The same-session positions ledger shows zero PROV shares, so there is nothing to hold, trim or exit. The levels below are entry and invalidation alerts for a future position, not broker orders.

holding_alerts.trigger: Close above the 50-day average of ₹1,900.75, including a gap-up on Monday 16 November after the H1 FY27 results
holding_alerts.instruction: Do not buy. Above the 50-day average we do nothing: at ₹1,902 the reward-to-risk to the ₹2,216 base target is exactly 1.5:1, and at ₹2,125.70 it is 0.21:1. Wait for a pullback.

holding_alerts.trigger: Daily close inside ₹1,850 to ₹1,875 after the market has absorbed the H1 FY27 results, with the weekly close above ₹1,845
holding_alerts.instruction: The entry window opens. Re-run the 1.5:1 test against the then-current base target before any purchase and size within the TIER_3 band of 2.0% to 3.5% of net worth; confirm the current NSE market lot first and skip the entry if it is 160 shares, which would be about 7% of net worth.

holding_alerts.trigger: Weekly close below the invalidation level
holding_alerts.instruction: Setup is invalid: move the verdict to REJECTED and remove PROV from the entry list. Do not widen the stop.

holding_alerts.trigger: Consolidated borrowings above ₹75 crore at 31 March 2027, or any equity raise
holding_alerts.instruction: Re-run the 1.5:1 gate with the financing cost or dilution included. Move to REJECTED if the repriced base target falls below ₹2,087, the level the zone bottom needs.

holding_alerts.trigger: FY2027 audited results (expected around May 2027) with positive operating cash flow and receivables at or below ₹60 crore at 31 March 2027 (about 16 days of base-case sales)
holding_alerts.instruction: Upgrade review: reassess ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP only if the price also gives at least 1.5:1 to the repriced base target.

holding_alerts.trigger: March 2027 receivables above ₹75 crore (over 20 days of sales) with a second negative operating-cash-flow build, a used-up related-party limit, or another auditor or promoter-group governance change
holding_alerts.instruction: Downgrade to REJECTED and remove from the entry list.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: The next marginal cash unit: the ₹1,45,415 of cash above the 10% ceiling (cash is 13.39% of the ₹42,91,664 net worth). No PROV proceeds are assumed because no PROV shares are held

destinations.recommendation: Fund 25% of the marginal unit (about ₹36,000) into AJMERA, the only active-shortlist name whose own dossier calls for an immediate buy at the live price.
destinations.rationale: AJMERA is IMMEDIATE_BUY with a Stage 2 snapshot, offers 4.64:1 to its ₹195.00 record target over the ₹119.98 snapshot stop, and the TIER_3 50 bps risk rule leaves about 0.96% of net worth of headroom above its 4.06% weight, which is 28.3% of the excess cash and is rounded down to 25%. MANORAMA is 1.9% above its entry zone and ZYDUSLIFE is in its zone but its own verdict is still WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT, so neither is funded here. AJMERA carries a Stage conflict (market-facts ledger Stage 3, TradingView snapshot and its own dossier Stage 2) and its own dossier was not re-underwritten in this run, so the slice is conditional on re-confirming the Stage.
destinations.entry_condition: Buy inside or at the support zone of ₹124.51 to ₹132.17 (live ₹133.28 is 0.8% above it) with a stop at ₹119.98; skip if the price runs well above the zone.

destinations.rationale: No outside equity was underwritten in this run; naming one would invent a destination without filings, valuation or downside work.
destinations.entry_condition: Fund only after a separate evidence-backed review finds a candidate that clears the business, valuation and 1.5:1 entry gates.

destinations.recommendation: Hold 75% of the marginal unit in cash.
destinations.rationale: PROV fails the 1.5:1 gate at the live ₹2,125.70 (0.21:1), the probability-weighted price is only 2.3% above the close, and the remaining shortlist names are either above their zones or carry WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT verdicts of their own.
destinations.entry_condition: Redeploy when PROV closes inside ₹1,850 to ₹1,875 with the gate intact, or when another shortlist or outside name clears its entry zone and 1.5:1.

horizons.rationale: RSI is 70.9 daily, 71.9 weekly and 70.8 on four hours, price is 9.4% above the 10-week EMA, the H1 FY27 results are unpriced and the median volume is 320 shares a day, so there is no practical trading edge.
H2 FY27 collections, the audited FY2027 operating cash flow and Surat Phases 2 and 3 by June 2027 decide whether profit turns into cash.
Narrow moat, about 14% self-funded growth against a brand-revenue guide near 29%, ROCE near 12% and a peer set that has not earned brand margins.

gate_exceptions: SESSION DATING: The market-facts ledger could not be built for 13 November 2026 because the Nifty 50 bar for that date was not yet in the ledger's source (the checker printed 'STALE DATA: benchmark Nifty 50 last bar is 2026-11-12, session is 2026-11-13'); one retry returned the same result, so under RUN_PROTOCOL section 0 the research as-of date is the verified 12 November session. A third attempt about three hours later did find the 13 November Nifty bar, but a ledger built for that date flagged 535 of 543 instruments as stale (their last bar was still 12 November), so the complete verified session remains 12 November and that 13 November ledger was not used. The TradingView scanner, retrieved about 07:00 IST on 14 November, did carry the 13 November session (Nifty 25,144.30; PROV close ₹2,125.70), so the decision price is the 13 November close and both closes are named in the text. This mixes two session dates for price; it lowers confidence in the benchmark-relative figures, which stop at 12 November, and would be cured by a ledger rebuild once the data source publishes the 13 November bar.

RESULTS NOT PRICED: The H1 FY27 results (six months to 30 September 2026) were filed at about 17:57 IST on 13 November 2026, after the 15:30 close, so neither the 12 November nor the 13 November close reflects them. Every multiple in the report pairs a price set before the news with earnings that include it, and the first possible market reaction is the Monday 16 November session. A gap in either direction could change the price levels; the verdict logic (entry only inside ₹1,850 to ₹1,875) is designed to survive that, but the levels should be re-tested after the reaction.

SCANNED FILINGS: The H1 FY27 results filing and several earlier company filings are scanned images, so some line items were read from rendered pages or OCR and carry a tolerance of about ₹1 lakh. One digit of the H1 FY27 inventory change was reconstructed from the printed subtotal and the balance sheet. The FY2026 earnings call of 20 May 2026 has audio only, with no published transcript, so management quotes from that call rely on secondary summaries and are not used as verbatim evidence.

TECHNICAL TOOLING: No Google Chrome TradingView tab was open, so the 1-week, 1-day and 4-hour lens uses the public TradingView scanner fields rather than a browser read of a logged-in chart. TheWrap market-wide Stage 2 dashboard was extracted for the India market but is dated 8 November 2026 and covers only companies above ₹1,000 crore of market value, so PROV (about ₹734 crore) is not in it. The NSE SME market lot for PROV was not verified; the 160-share prospectus lot is used as a cautionary illustration and recorded volumes hint at a smaller lot.

CITATION FRESHNESS: the citation check, run with the stale as-of allowance, returned PASS WITH EXCEPTIONS. 47 of the 64 research records describe periods more than 60 days before the 12 November 2026 report date. Each as-of date is true to the period it describes. None was edited to pass. Newer evidence exists only for H1 FY27, filed 13 November 2026, and the 30 September 2026 shareholding. Both are cited. REVIEW STATUS: The independent reviewer returned REVISE in round 1 (nine findings, all fixed) and APPROVE in round 2. The red team, whose configured model (ao-foundry-lc/gpt-6.1-sol) was not available and was replaced by the runner's default agent, returned verdict_should_be_stricter on its first pass; the reviewer's configured id (azure//claude-sonnet-5-5) resolved to azure/claude-sonnet-5-5. In answer to the red team the entry zone was tightened from ₹1,850-₹1,900 to ₹1,850-₹1,875, a financing check (interest and dilution) and a direct answer on REJECTED were added, and the red team's round 2 returned verdict_holds. Those edits came after the reviewer's final APPROVE, so they were verified by the code gates and the red team's round 2 but not re-read by the independent reviewer, because the two-round cap was reached. The status for those edits is BEST_EFFORT_AFTER_REVIEW_LIMIT. The red team's remaining notes are disclosed in the text, chiefly that the margin cushion in the financing check is partly seasonal.

SOURCE LIMITS: Management's 22.1% 'gross margin', ₹75 crore marketing figure, working-capital cycle and several market-size and per-capita figures cannot be reconciled with the audited statements or with each other; the report states both versions. No product-level revenue, channel mix after FY2023 or segment margin is disclosed. The adverse-news search for regulatory actions was rate-limited, so 'not found' is not proof of absence. The Prov Foods subsidiary accounts and any NSE main-board migration filing were not located.
